subject: PO acknowledgement, serial invoices & ledger tagging
thread_content:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@novacorp.com, Tom Blake <t.blake@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 78914 — invoicing cadence + PO acknowledgement

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is pulling together the PO for the initial commitment (PO 78914). A couple of questions from our AP team before we issue:

- We need confirmation that Redwood can accept a single PO and support multiple sequential invoices against it (monthly installments). Can you confirm invoice lines will reference PO 78914 each time?
- Our ERP requires a PO acknowledgement from the vendor. Do you provide a signed PO acknowledgement (PDF) that references the PO number and acceptance date?
- We also need the ability to map our internal ledger tags (charge codes) on each invoice line. Is there an invoice metadata field you can populate, or will this need a mapping file on our side?
- Standard payment terms at NovaCorp are net30, but Finance can accept net45 occasionally for new vendor setups. What flexibility do you have?

Appreciate a short note — finance is hoping to submit the PO by EOW.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaCorp

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 78914 — invoicing cadence + PO acknowledgement

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front, details below:

- Yes, we can invoice multiple times against one PO (serial invoices).
- We provide a PO acknowledgement PDF that includes the PO number and acceptance date.
- We can include a vendor-level invoice field for your charge code (custom ledger tag), and we can also accept a simple CSV mapping for ERP alignment.
- Net30 is our standard on hosted accounts; net45 can be approved on a per-account basis (requires billing review).

To make this production-ready we have a couple of administrative asks:
1) Please confirm whether you want equal monthly installments or milestone-based invoices (e.g., 30%/30%/40%).
2) If you choose monthly installments, confirm the first invoice month and whether the PO will be replenished/blanket for 12 months.
3) Please attach a sample ledger tag for one line item so Priyom can verify formatting.

I've looped in Vivek (billing) and Priyom (platform partnerships) — Vivek will confirm net-term flexibility and provide the PO acknowledgement PDF and a sample invoice template. Priyom will share the CSV mapping format for ledger tags.

Thanks — I can turn around the acknowledgement ASAP once we have the PO number and invoice cadence.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO 78914 — invoicing cadence + PO acknowledgement

Hi Elena — Vivek on Billing. Quick rundown and what I'll attach:

1) Invoicing against a single PO: supported. We will include PO_78914 on every invoice line and in the invoice header. In our system invoices will be sequenced (INV-2027-78914-001, -002, etc.) so your AP team can easily reconcile serial invoices.

2) PO acknowledgement: we generate a vendor PO acknowledgement PDF with vendor signature and acceptance date. Draft attached as "PO_78914.pdf" for example/format. If you need it signed and returned, let us know — we can return a signed copy.

3) Ledger tags / charge codes: we support a custom free-text field called "vendor_charge_code" on each invoice line. To simplify ERP mapping, attach a CSV with columns: external_charge_code, redwood_charge_code, description. Priyom will provide the CSV template; I attach a sample mapping file "ledger_tag_mapping.csv". If your ERP requires a specific XML/EDI format we can discuss an export, but CSV is usually sufficient.

4) Net terms: our standard hosted net term is net30. Net45 or net60 can be accommodated but require an approval from Finance for extended terms; this typically takes 2–3 business days once we see the PO and customer credit profile. For new customers we often start with net30 and move to net45 after a billing cycle.

5) Billing schedule options:
   - Option A: Monthly equal installments (standard) — invoices issued on the 1st of each month referencing the PO.
   - Option B: Milestone invoices (dates provided by buyer) — requires milestone acceptance by the customer.
   - Option C: Quarterly invoices — possible for larger commitments.

6) Amendment / contract change: because you requested net-term flexibility and a blanket PO, we'll attach a short amendment to the MSA capturing the invoice cadence and net terms (draft attached "msa-amendment-draft.pdf"). We can route that via DocuSign if accepted.

Next steps from our side: I will generate the official PO acknowledgement (signed if you prefer) and an initial invoice schedule for Option A (monthly). Priyom — can you confirm the CSV template is correct for NovaCorp?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_78914.pdf (pdf stub), ledger_tag_mapping.csv (csv stub), msa-amendment-draft.pdf (pdf stub)

---

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@novacorp.com>, finance@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 78914 — invoicing cadence + PO acknowledgement

Marissa / Vivek — this is great, thanks.

We will proceed with Option A (monthly equal installments). PO_78914 will be a blanket PO covering 12 months beginning June 1, 2027. Please:

- Issue the first invoice on June 1, 2027 (INV-2027-78914-001) and include PO_78914 in the header and each line.
- Include a vendor_charge_code column on each invoice line and set the value to our external charge code when you get it. I attached an example charge code lookup for one SKU in the reply (see attachment).
- We accept net30 for the initial cycle — once billing clears we will revisit net45 for the next quarter.
- Please send the signed PO acknowledgement PDF and the DocuSign link for the MSA amendment so I can route internally.

If you can send the signed acknowledgement and the invoice schedule by EOD Wednesday that will let us approve the PO and kick off our supplier setup.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaCorp
